balanced_budget.tolerance_note: £5,000. Government returns are published to the nearest £1,000, so sums of rounded lines can differ by a few thousand pounds. Anything larger is shown as still to find or spare, never rounded to balanced.

2026-27.applies_to: Relevant local authorities, including London borough councils (Annex B)
2026-27.note: A rise of 5% or more is excessive and needs a referendum, so councils in this category stop at 4.99%.

2027-28.applies_to: Hammersmith and Fulham, one of six low council tax authorities named by government
2027-28.note: Government confirmed its intention not to set referendum principles for 2027-28 and 2028-29 for City of London, Hammersmith and Fulham, Kensington and Chelsea, Wandsworth, Westminster and Windsor and Maidenhead.
